spanish: Y el alzante el cadáver de ellos lavará sus vestidos, y se impurecerá hasta la tarde; impuros ellos a ustedes.

findings.issue: Definite qal participle plus object marker is smoothed as two bare noun phrases; the carcass remains the object of the lifter, with no added participant.
findings.spanishSpan: el alzante el cadáver de ellos

findings.issue: Qal sequential perfect is a stative be/become unclean; pronominal se impurecerá is inchoative smoothing and can sound reflexive, without a new actor or a causative stem.
Definite עֶרֶב is evening; la tarde in current Latin American Spanish often means afternoon, so the time limit is slightly uncertain.

notes: Number, person, and the verbless טמאים המה לכם clause match; ustedes is the licensed 2mp address.
